capabilities: Resolve wikilinks to existing vault folders instead of creating new files
Intercept clicks on links whose target is a folder
Reveal, expand, or open the first note of the linked folder in the sidebar
Style folder links in Live Preview as valid links or with a custom color
Disable new-file creation for unresolved ghost links
disambiguation: Unlike similar plugins, it does not create hidden notes for folders or require special link syntax.
extras: The author states the plugin was vibe-coded with GoogleAI for personal use with no guarantee of quality; the listing also notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances how Obsidian handles wikilink following as well as wikilink display in the Live Editor pane.
problem: Obsidian has no support for wikilinks to directories; such links show as unresolved ghost links and clicking one creates a new empty markdown file.
summary: Plugin that lets [[wikilinks]] point to folders, controlling how those links display and what happens when they are clicked.
